crime_highlights: he was in a position of trust which he breached repeatedly over a period of three years
his actions led to the theft of over $900,000 of public funds
The plundering of the organizations destroyed those organizations and caused the loss of jobs of innocent people
He was the architect of the scheme
rationale_highlights: the factors leading to the offending conduct include the abuse he suffered as a child
I accept, to some extent, those influences arise from the particular challenges facing people in the aboriginal population and require consideration of the Gladue principles

absent the circumstances giving rise to consideration of the Gladue principles and the negative impact of incarceration on the offender's family, a sentence more in keeping with the Crown's submission in the range of three to four years would be appropriate
note: Gladue passage is about Morrison; Wells co-offender also discussed.

crime_highlights: Mr. Swite entered Ms. Hill's apartment and began searching for cigarettes and cash
Mr. Swite pushed her to the bed
Mr. Swite then place a pillow over the head of Ms. Hill and sat on her, holding the pillow to her face with sufficient force that she died from asphyxiation after approximately 5 minutes
rationale_highlights: Applying the Gladue principles, through the lens of Ipeelee, Mr. Swite was an Aboriginal person raised on a reserve in deprived circumstances
Much of that resulted from systemic racism
Any person in those circumstances would have little chance of avoiding the perilous lifestyle patterns that Mr. Swite fell into
I find the mitigating circumstances, including the circumstances surrounding the Aboriginal status of Mr. Swite, warrants a somewhat lesser period
note: Rationale slightly over 350 words because para 30 is long.

crime_highlights: the accused Mr. Wells splashed gasoline all over the front porch of Mr. Conto's house and lit it on fire
The house was quickly engulfed in flames
The two victims were overcome by smoke and unable to escape
Two men died as a result
rationale_highlights: His character is, in part, the result of his history as an aboriginal person, raised during his formative years in aboriginal surroundings
considering the effect and results of your heritage and that you have had to deal with that
it should result in a reduction of the sentence that would otherwise be appropriate
it will also be reduced by a period of six months from what it would otherwise be, as a result of my consideration of your background under 718.2(e)
